verdict.rationale: The evidence pack markets the 9950X3D for creative workloads (DaVinci Resolve, color grading, rendering) but contains no mention of dedicated hardware encode/decode media engines, AV1/HEVC/ProRes acceleration blocks, or Quick Sync-equivalent fixed-function silicon on this CPU. As a desktop CPU marketed partly to creators, this is a fair axis to ask about, but no documentation supports it.
